description: A React component running exclusively on the server that can await databases or fetch calls directly inside its function body before rendering.
Sequential data requests where a child component waits for a parent render or effect to finish before starting its own network call.
The transition from Server Components to 'use client' components where every passed prop must be serializable rather than a live database handle or plain function.
A plain, explicit object shape containing only the sanitized, serializable fields a Client Component needs to render.
Placing a data read directly inside the Server Component that renders the data instead of hoisting all requests into a top-level client effect.
